title: The 4 Best Bread Machines for Gluten-Free Bread in 2026
h1: The 4 Best Bread Machines for Gluten-Free Bread in 2026
metaDescription: Our 4 picks for bread machines for gluten-free bread in 2026, with key specs, strengths and limitations for each, based on manufacturer specs, independent reviews and owner reports.
lede: We looked at bread machines for gluten-free bread in 2026 using manufacturer specs, independent reviews and owner reports. Each pick lists what it does well and where it falls short, so you can match it to how you'll use it.

products.name: Zojirushi Virtuoso Plus BB-PDC20 Bread Maker
products.blurb: Key specs: 2-lb loaf capacity, Dual heaters, lid plus bottom, Double kneading blades.
strengths: Dual heaters set the crust from the top as well as the bottom, which helps a gluten-free loaf hold its shape before it can sink
Double kneading blades handle the thick, batter-like gluten-free dough more evenly than a single-blade machine
Large viewing window makes it easy to check the batter consistency mid-cycle without opening the lid
Long track record as the most consistently top-rated machine in the category
limitations: Vertical loaf shape is taller and narrower than a sandwich-style loaf
Kneading motor is audible during the mix cycle

products.name: Cuisinart CBK-200 Convection Bread Maker
products.blurb: Key specs: 2-lb capacity, Convection fan, 16 menu presets.
strengths: Convection fan circulates heat around the pan for a more even bake than a non-convection machine
16 presets include a dedicated gluten-free cycle plus low-carb and artisan dough options
3 loaf sizes add flexibility that most gluten-free bakers appreciate for smaller test batches
Power-failure backup protects a cycle already in progress
limitations: Horizontal pan has a bulkier footprint on the counter than a vertical machine
Convection fan adds a noticeable hum during the bake cycle
No dual-heater lid, so crust evenness trails the Zojirushi slightly

products.name: Breville Custom Loaf BBM800XL Bread Maker
products.blurb: Key specs: 1 to 2.5-lb loaf range, 13-plus automatic programs, Collapsible kneading paddle.
strengths: Collapsible paddle folds flat during baking, leaving a much smaller hole in gluten-free loaves than a fixed paddle
Widest loaf-size range in this list, useful for dialing in a smaller gluten-free test loaf before committing to a full batch
Automatic dispenser adds seeds or dried fruit at the right point without opening the lid
9 custom settings allow fine control over crust color and cycle length
limitations: Fewer total ratings than Hamilton Beach or Zojirushi, so there is less long-term owner data
Larger footprint takes up more counter space than the Cuisinart

products.name: Hamilton Beach Digital Bread Maker 29885
products.blurb: Key specs: 2-lb capacity, 14 programmable settings, Gluten-free and artisan settings.
strengths: 14 settings including a labeled gluten-free cycle cover most home baking needs
Dishwasher-safe pan and paddle simplify cleanup after a sticky gluten-free batter
limitations: Single heating element produces a less even crust than the dual-heater Zojirushi
Kneading paddle is more prone to sticking inside a gluten-free loaf on removal
Shorter reported lifespan than the premium machines under heavy weekly use

howWeChose: Picks are based on manufacturer specs, independent reviews and owner reports. We don't claim our own testing.
We do not list prices or star ratings because they change. Check Amazon for current details.
